# `dashboard/routes/producers.ts`

## Overview

This module provides route handling and utility functionality for the producers section of the dashboard. It includes helpers for formatting and displaying producer-related data.

---

## Exports

### `formatIntervalMs`

> **Note:** This function is not directly exported from this module. It can be imported via:
> ```ts
> import { formatIntervalMs } from '...'
> ```

Formats a duration given in milliseconds into a human-readable string representation.

#### Signature

```ts
function formatIntervalMs(ms: number): string
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Type | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `ms` | `number` | The duration in milliseconds to format. |

#### Returns

`string` — A formatted string representation of the given millisecond interval.

#### Example

```ts
const formatted = formatIntervalMs(3000);
// e.g. returns "3s"

const formatted2 = formatIntervalMs(90000);
// e.g. returns "1m 30s"
```
